bundle.shortDescription: A window over the QuantRule gateway
bundle.longDescription: The QuantRule desktop package. The shell loads the gateway URL and starts the six bundled services on loopback when the desktop profile is packaged. It owns no IPC command, no engine, and no local domain data.
